title: Crestline Companion Fare Payment Reference
content:
Every companion booking carries a companion fare, which the holder pays in person as its own charge entry of component companion fare on the ledger of the certificate or pass, naming the companion ticket of the booking. This holds on every product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes.

## Capability

`pay_companion_fare_charge_130546ae` lets the certificate or pass holder pay, in person, the companion fare of a companion booking. One run records one paid charge of component companion fare, dated today, on that certificate's or pass's charge history, linked to the companion ticket of the booking. The holder's companion charges rise by the amount paid and the holder sees the companion fare as paid.

## How it is invoked

The companion fare is paid by the holder. The agent unlocks `pay_companion_fare_charge_130546ae` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `companion_id` | Reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the booking was made on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup | identifier |
| `companion_ticket_number` | The companion's ticket number on the booking, exactly as shown on that booking's entry in the companion trip and charge history | 13 digits beginning 419, digits only, no spaces |
| `amount` | The companion fare being paid | USD, decimal rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; never negative |

## Return

A receipt confirming the payment with `charge_entry_id` (reference of the new paid charge), `companion_id`, `companion_ticket_number`, `charge_component` (always `companion_fare`), `amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places, the amount paid), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status` (`payment_recorded` when the payment is on file). No error receipt is defined.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A run with a ticket number of the form 4191234567890 and an amount of 119.00 returns `charge_component` `companion_fare`, `amount_usd` 119.00 and `status` `payment_recorded`.
